sources.snippet: Based on the best-performing YOLOv11s model, this study developed a multi-function AI-assisted system that integrates pressure injury (PI) lesion detection, automated staging, and wound size measurement, and deployed it as a web-based application using the Streamlit framework, designated PI-3DAS.
